title: Dr. Logan's death and Duke's last illness
summary: Dr. Arthur Logan's death was a blow; Duke was sick on his last trip and Cootie sent prayers via Mercer.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: Well, listen, just one other thing I wanted to ask you about that. About Arthur Logan. What an awful blow for everybody.
Yeah.
Huh?
Yeah. It really was an awful blow.
A terrible thing for Duke.
Oh, yeah.
And him ill, and -- Cootie, did you figure that Duke was starting to feel poorly?
Oh, yeah.
Could you tell?

Yeah. That last trip we was on. See, he was working night by night. And I know he was sick. He was just barely making it. He told Mercer don't take the bus too far away from him, because he may have to leave any minute, to come home. That's when he left to come home.
Yeah.
And he brought the bus on back.
Yeah. Did you talk to him while he was in hospital?
No. I didn't get a chance to go up there. They didn't want any visitors. I used to send a message by Mercer.
No. I just wondered maybe if you talked to him on the phone or anything.
No. I didn't want to disturb him.
No.
I used to tell Mercer to tell him I'm saying a prayer for him every day.
Yeah. Yeah. And of course Harry was in hospital at that time, because Harry got pneumonia. Remember?
Harry got sick?
Well, Harry got sick while Duke was in the hospital. He had pneumonia.
Harry got sick before Duke.
Yeah. But then he came -- then he got better.
Then he got better.
Then he got better, but he was in the hospital then, you know with pneumonia. Because I know Duke called him to see if he was all right.
Uh-huh.
